answer: Because the crystal cliff is fixed at deposit and recorded in the delta ledger, the mesa audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 23 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. A farm of 97 pays that 201 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
